title: Patient 17's implant, cut from his leg and tested for zinc-64

tellings.quote: Like patient 17, terrifying. He didn't tell me that till after I saw it got cut out of his leg.

plain: A man known only as Patient 17 had a small object, said to be an alien implant, cut out of his leg, and it was then tested for zinc-64, a particular form of the element zinc, according to Jeremy Corbell, a maker of UFO documentaries who says he watched it being removed. Corbell calls the case terrifying and says the man only told him his story after Corbell had seen the removal. He links it to the work of Roger Leir, a surgeon who removed such objects, and of Jacques Vallée, a computer scientist and longtime UFO researcher.
